ratings.comment: Dr. Urrutia is not very understanding of sickness or other circumstances, unlike the majority of professors at UW Madison. For the introductory level of the class, the exams are extremely difficult and the class averages were always low, with no curve. I increased my studying for each exam and continued to score low. Do not take this class.
She is the least helpful professor I have encountered during my time in Madison. She is extremely unwilling to communicate with her students and had lied to me about homeworks I turned in.

Her lectures were so hard to understand because she doesn't know how to explain any of the concepts so you're pretty much left to learn everything yourself. Also, the average class grade on all of our tests was around a 70% every time and she never curved it a single time. Highly advise against taking this class or any course taught by her.
Most valuable player in the Soil Science Department. Her lab is very organized and you get to do a lot of different things. Plus she is very kind and willing to help students understand the material.

Not worth the stress for physical science credit. Tests are insanely hard, and there's not even close to enough time to finish them. Lectures are so dense, and she goes too fast to take decent notes. Grading was tough, and she never released exam answers or class averages, so you don't know where you sit in the class. Avoid at all costs.
